text.div: Patient Document generated by Health Intersections Patient Health Document Generator

I came to Australia from Afghanistan 3 years ago. I have epilepsy which started during my pregnancy. My daughter Aisha is now 8 months old and has been diagnosed with developmental delays. I am very worried about both our health needs. I prefer female doctors and need interpreters for medical appointments as my English is still limited. I am breastfeeding and concerned about my seizure medications affecting my baby.

Patient's Goals

  • Control seizures while safely breastfeeding
  • Get early intervention services for my daughter
  • Improve English language skills for healthcare
